Southeast Alaska Inside Waters from Dixon Entrance to Skagway

Wind forecasts reflect the predominant speed and direction
expected. Sea forecasts represent the average of the highest
one-third of the combined windwave and swell height.

.TODAY...SE wind 10 kt becoming N in the morning, then becoming
light in the afternoon. Seas 2 ft or less. Showers early in the
morning.
.TONIGHT...SE wind 15 kt increasing to 25 kt late. Gusts to 40 kt
late. Seas 4 ft. Rain late.
.MON...S wind 25 kt. Seas 5 ft. Rain in the morning, then
showers in the afternoon.
.MON NIGHT...SE wind 20 kt. Seas 4 ft. Showers.
.TUE...N wind 30 kt. Seas 6 ft.
.WED...N wind 25 kt. Seas 4 ft.
.THU...N wind 25 kt. Seas 4 ft.

events.region: Anegada Passage east of Virgin Gorda and Saint Croix south to 17N; Caribbean Waters of Puerto Rico from 10 NM to 17N, including the Coastal Waters of Saint Croix
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
The areas affected include...
Anegada Passage east of Virgin Gorda and Saint Croix south to
17N...
Caribbean Waters of Puerto Rico from 10 NM to 17N, including the
Coastal Waters of Saint Croix...

At 740 AM AST, Doppler radar indicated strong thunderstorms, capable
of producing winds to around 40 knots and frequent lightning.. These
thunderstorms were located over the waters around St Croix, moving
southwest at 15 knots.
